subject: gk
question: CBIC stands for _______.

options.text: Central Bureau of Investigation and Committee
Central Board on Issues Related to Caste
Central Board of Information and Communication
Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs

solution:
The correct answer is __**Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **CBIC stands for Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs.**

 
 
• CBIC is a part of the Department of Revenue under the Ministry of Finance in India.
 
• It is responsible for the administration of indirect taxes such as Goods and Services Tax (GST), Customs, and Central Excise.
 
• CBIC also plays a crucial role in preventing smuggling and enforcing trade laws and regulations.
 
• The board is headed by a Chairperson and has several members who oversee different departments and functions related to indirect taxes and customs. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Central Bureau of Investigation and Committee:-**

 
 
• The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) is a premier investigation agency in India that deals with high-profile cases of corruption, economic offenses, and other serious crimes.
 
• A committee is a group of people appointed to perform a specific task or function.
